title: Catalog lifecycle signal broker and deprecation calendar
creator: Sofia Chen
description:
Problem: Enterprise customers submit a mix of requests — new model adds, pinning asks, deprecation requests — and PM/Eng currently triage them manually with inconsistent signal weighting. This causes slow responses for time-sensitive pins, missed deprecation notifications, and surprising regressions when model variants roll out.

Goal: Design a repeatable intake + prioritization flow that combines usage/customer SLAs, security/regulatory constraints, eval-regressions, resource footprint, and maintainability signals into a single 'signal broker' score. Pair that with a deprecation calendar and migration runway that is visible to customers and integrated with the Console.

Scope:
- Intake scoring system (signal broker) that scores each catalog request across 6 dimensions: customer impact, operational risk, eval regression, infra cost footprint, privacy/compliance constraints, and rollout complexity.
- Concrete thresholds and lane mapping (fast-track, scheduled, migration-assisted, archival).
- Eval-gate definitions for model acceptance and pinning (what failure rates/metrics block a pin).
- Deprecation calendar UI/automation: 90/60/30 notifications, automatic compatibility checks, and a churn budget to delay deprecations for high-impact customers.
- Migration aids: compatibility adapter library, sample prompt regression suite, and suggested ~2-week canary+shadow path for enterprise.
- Integrations: console UI labels, catalog metadata fields, internal triage dashboard, and automated emails to customer contacts.

Out of scope: full infra implementation of kernels/quant ops; deep eval harness rewrites. This is a product + lightweight infra spec and acceptance criteria for the initial implementation.

Non-goals: remove human judgement entirely; we will provide recommended lanes with manual override and audit trail.
acceptance_criteria: Signal broker spec created with weightings for six dimensions and example scoring decisions for 10 representative customer requests
Mapping documented from score ranges to triage lanes (fast-track, scheduled, migration-assisted, archival)
Eval-gate thresholds defined for common regressions (generation-quality drop, hallucination spike, latency regression) with examples and measurement queries
Deprecation calendar feature spec that describes 90/60/30 day notifications, tenant-specific churn budget, and manual override path
Console mockups for inbox/notification and per-model lifecycle page showing status and migration resources
Runbook for triage rotation (PM/Eng/Customer Success) and criteria for security_review_required flag
Integration checklist with catalog metadata (fields added), triage dashboard refresh, and outgoing notification templates

2026-02-22 Jordan Kim: Draft scoring rubric posted: weights proposed: customer_impact=30, eval_regression=25, infra_cost=15, compliance=15, rollout_complexity=10, maintenance_burden=5. Need feedback on weighting trade-offs from infra and legal.

2026-02-26 Marcos Ruiz (Infra): Concern raised about infra_cost weight vs. customer impact for enterprise accounts with reserved capacity. Suggested adding 'reserved-capacity override' to ensure committed customers aren't deprioritized.

2026-03-01 Ava Patel (Security): Security checklist added. Flagging that any model handling regulated PII requires mandatory security_review_required=true and at least one on-prem verification run. Legal requests email templates for deprecation notices.

2026-03-03 Design (Lena Park): Uploaded Console mockups (Drive link below). Suggests an expand/collapse lifecycle timeline per model and a clear 'migration assistance' CTA for migration-assisted lane.

2026-03-07 Jordan Kim: Experiment plan for eval gates: run golden-prompt set and business-critical prompt set; block if hallucination delta > 4 percentage points or throughput latency p95 increases >25% on representative infra. Need eng to validate feasibility of automated blocking queries.

2026-03-09 Sofia Chen: Decision: signal broker will be advisory by default but recommendations surface as 'recommended lane' in Console; manual override logged and requires reason. Added customer_impact=high for prioritized enterprise requests.

2026-03-10 Jordan Kim: Added dependencies and next steps. Tailoring proposal to support both hosted API and Dedicated customers with reserved-capacity override and per-tenant churn budgets. Ready for review in next PM sync.
next_steps: Collect final weight feedback from infra/legal by 2026-03-17; finalize eval-gate measurement queries with ENG; hand off mockups to frontend for Console inbox wiring; schedule 1-week pilot for 10 enterprise requests in April
notes: Trade-offs: heavier customer_impact weight speeds enterprise requests but can increase infra spend. Chose advisory-first approach to keep human oversight. Will iterate weights after a 4-week pilot.
